entities.name: EPS Session Management
entities.description: The ESM sublayer supports EPS bearer context handling in the UE and MME. It comprises procedures for activation, deactivation, and modification of EPS bearer contexts, resource requests, and user data transport via control plane.

entities.name: EPS Bearer Context
entities.description: Represents an EPS bearer between UE and PDN. Can be default or dedicated type. Remains activated even if underlying radio/S1 bearers are temporarily released.

entities.name: Default EPS Bearer Context
entities.description: Activated when UE requests connection to a PDN. Remains active throughout PDN connection lifetime. First default bearer can be activated during EPS attach procedure.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS Bearer Context
entities.description: Linked to a default EPS bearer context, providing additional bearer resources. Activated by network and released when default bearer is released.

entities.name: EMM Context Established
entities.description: ESM procedures generally require an established EMM context between UE and MME with secure NAS message exchange initiated.

entities.name: EPS Attach Procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the first default EPS bearer context can be activated.

entities.name: Non-IP PDN Type
entities.description: Network shall not initiate dedicated bearer context activation for established PDN connections of non-IP type.
